name: Execute outcome=kept → replace_owned best.value + best.experiment_id on run entity
description:
ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign autoresearch pack — empirical-reviewer scalar-upsert half. 2026-06-03 fix for the first-write-wins trap that made synthesize and the next propose iteration read stale baseline.value as the best.

## The bug this rule fixes

emit_autoresearch_measurement (the empirical-compare Go executor) used to AddTriple autoresearch.best.value + autoresearch.best.experiment-id on the RUN entity when outcome=kept. Storage is per-(subject, predicate, object) set semantics + GetFieldValue returns the FIRST matching triple for scalar operators. So once emit_autoresearch_baseline stamped best.value=<baseline>, every later AddTriple of a better value landed as a SEPARATE triple AND was invisible to scalar reads. Synthesize substituted `$entity.triple.autoresearch.best.value` and got baseline back; rule 05's propose persona had the same problem.

The TriplePublisher interface upstream exposes only AddTriple / AddTriplesBatch — no upsert primitive. So we can't fix this in the executor. The rule engine provides `replace_owned` (ADR-056 Decision 3, semstreams#283 / beta.110): an ATOMIC owned replace-by-(subject, predicate) via update_with_triples — one KV revision, no read-between-revisions gap. best.value + best.experiment_id are single-valued running-max state owned by the `rule-pack.semteams` projection contract (entity_pattern *.*.agent.chain.execution.* — the run anchor; declared in flow-bootstrap.json), so they belong on the owned-replace lane, not the bare append lane. This supersedes the earlier non-atomic `update_triple` remove-then-add (two revisions, semstreams#147 / beta.83), which this rule used 2026-06-03..2026-06-14.

## How this rule works

Fires on the EXECUTE entity when emit_autoresearch_measurement stamps `autoresearch.measurement.outcome=kept`. Two replace_owned actions then upsert best.value + best.experiment_id on the RUN entity via subject-override + entity.triple substitution (the predicate is a literal — replace_owned forbids `$` in the predicate — while subject + object accept substitution as before):

- `subject = $entity.triple.agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id` — the run entity (the coordinator's loop entity)
- `predicate = autoresearch.best.value`
- `object = $entity.triple.autoresearch.measurement.value` — substitutes the new measurement value from the firing execute entity

emit_autoresearch_measurement batches measurement.* stamps into one AddTriplesBatch call, so when this rule fires on outcome=kept, the measurement.value triple is co-located and the substitution resolves to the current measurement's value.

## Why this lives in rule 04c and not as a separate path

Rule 04a fires on execute clean completion (`agent.loop.outcome=success` + `decide=measured`) and stamps experiment.completed. Rule 04c fires on the earlier `measurement.outcome=kept` stamp — these are different events with different conditions. They could in principle be merged, but keeping them separate (a) preserves rule 04a's narrow contract (counter stamp only, regardless of outcome) and (b) makes rule 04c's replace_owned semantics scoped exactly to the kept-outcome case.

metadata.fixes: Stale best.value read by synthesize + next propose iteration. Phase-A smoke 2026-06-03 surfaced the bug: real-LLM convergence ran 1.037s → 0.105s across 2 kept iterations, but synthesize reported best=1.037 (baseline) instead of 0.105.
metadata.ordering_with_rule_04a: Rule 04c fires on autoresearch.measurement.outcome=kept (stamped by the emit executor's AddTriplesBatch). Rule 04a fires on agent.loop.outcome=success + decide=measured (stamped at execute loop completion, a separate event). The order between them is undefined and irrelevant — both stamp on different subjects with different predicates.
metadata.replace_owned_requires: semstreams beta.110+ (#283, ADR-056 Decision 3) — atomic owned replace-by-(subject,predicate) via update_with_triples. Requires the rule processor to declare pack_id (owner rule-pack.semteams) + a replace-owned projection_contract group listing autoresearch.best.value + autoresearch.best.experiment-id (configs/flow-bootstrap.json); a replace_owned predicate outside that envelope HARD-FAILS boot. Supersedes the non-atomic update_triple remove-then-add (#147/beta.83) used 2026-06-03..2026-06-14.
metadata.substitution_pattern: $entity.triple.autoresearch.measurement.value reads the measurement value from the firing execute entity. emit_autoresearch_measurement batches all measurement.* stamps in one AddTriplesBatch so the triple is co-located when this rule fires.
